phase: Weekly crypto option premium selling (BTC, ETH) on Deribit public trade history
written_before_any_result: 2026-10-03. Only endpoint reachability and field names were checked; no price, trade or return has been downloaded or computed.
data: Deribit public API: option trades (history.deribit.com get_last_trades_by_currency_and_time: price in coin, iv, index_price, direction, instrument), delivery prices (get_delivery_prices), daily perpetual closes (get_tradingview_chart_data, BTC-PERPETUAL / ETH-PERPETUAL, 1D). Stored privately; aggregates only in the repo.
decision: Every Friday 08:00 UTC (weekly expiry time). Entry window 08:00-10:00 UTC. Underlying reference S0 = median index_price of all option trades of that currency in the window.
contract: Options expiring the next Friday at 08:00 UTC (7 days). Strike = the strike nearest S0 among strikes for which both the call and the put have at least one taker-sell trade (direction = 'sell') in the window; if none, the week is skipped and counted.
entry_price: per leg, the amount-weighted average price (coin) of taker-sell trades in the window: a seller hitting bids, i.e. an executable short price
settlement: payoff in coin = max(D - K, 0) / D for calls and max(K - D, 0) / D for puts, D = Deribit delivery price on the expiry date
fees: 0.0003 coin per leg trade fee (capped at 12.5% of the leg price) plus 0.00015 coin per leg delivery fee
returns: per week, per 1 coin notional: sum over sold legs of (entry price - payoff - fees), in coin (a fraction of notional)
model: HAR on daily log returns of the perpetual's 00:00 UTC closes: log(mean squared return over the next 7 days) on logs of mean squared returns over the last 1, 7, 30 and 90 days, least squares refitted each 1 January on pairs ending before it (needs >= 500 pairs); sigma_hat = sqrt(365 x forecast); signal ratio = (mean trade iv of the sold legs / 100) / sigma_hat using the forecast made at the previous 00:00 close
rules: coin {BTC, ETH} x instrument {straddle, put} x {always, ratio >= 1.1, ratio >= 1.25, ratio >= 1.5} = 16
statistics: weekly series (inactive weeks 0); Sharpe = mean / sd x sqrt(52); moving-block bootstrap of weeks (block 8, 2,000 draws) for the interval and t
samples: dev: Fridays 2020-01-01 to 2022-12-31; test: Fridays from 2023-01-01. Earlier Fridays only feed the HAR history.
freeze_rule: Per (coin, instrument), freeze the rule with the highest dev Sharpe among the four if its dev block t >= 2.0 (always-selling may be frozen: plain premium selling is itself a candidate). Also report the equal-weight portfolio of all frozen rules.
test_gates: Strong for a frozen rule or the portfolio: (1) bootstrap lower bound of the weekly mean > 0, (2) Sharpe >= 1.0, (3) block t >= 2.0, (4) worst week no worse than -3 x the mean annual return (sum of weekly returns per year), (5) positive mean in at least 2 of the test years 2023, 2024, 2025.
caveats: Taker-sell VWAP in a 2-hour window may include trades from much larger or smaller orders than a strategy would place.
Coin-margined P&L: returns are in coin, not USD; a USD investor also carries the coin's price risk unless hedged.
Exchange and counterparty risk (Deribit) are not modelled.
